anomalies.observed: The netlist contains two MCU footprints connected in parallel: U2 is ATtiny45-20P (DIP-8) and U3 is ATtiny13V-10S (SOIC-8W). U3 shares every MCU net with U2: VCC to +5V, GND to GND, reset to RST, I2C pins to SDA/SCK, analog input to POT, tach input to TACH, and PWM/MISO to PWM. There is no DNP or selection indication in the netlist.
anomalies.expected: The specification describes the board as 'an ATtiny-driven fan controller' (singular). If the board is intended to have a single ATtiny, only one MCU should be populated/represented. If dual footprints are intentional, only one should be populated or the other should be clearly non-populated; additionally, an ATtiny13V part should not be powered from the +5V rail if its rating is low-voltage.
anomalies.impact: If both MCU footprints are populated, their push-pull outputs can contend, especially on PWM/PB1, and the board may draw excess current, behave unpredictably, or damage one or both MCUs. U3 being an ATtiny13V part on the +5V rail is also questionable if that variant is low-voltage.
